citations.claim: energy explodes ~6x at first step exceeding allowed 4089 with no controller work
heavy body speed jumps from ~16.3 to ~51.8 gaining energy from lighter body

counterfactual.change: Moved body 1 x from 17.3 to 18.0 to prevent contact in the single step; energy then conserved and no violation, showing collision resolution caused the blow-up.

explanation: No controller work (disabled) and one dt step, yet energy jumps 3712->23651J. Bodies start 2.0 apart head-on at closing speed ~58 m/s and end touching (gap -0.0009) after 6 substeps. Heavy body (m=16.6) reverses from vx -16.3 to +45.75 while light body barely slows (42.0->38.3), massively increasing both momentum and kinetic energy. Likely cause: circle-circle impulse applied repeatedly across substeps and/or with positional-correction velocity injection, double-counting the impulse for disparate masses at high closing speed instead of a single momentum-conserving impulse.
vision_note: Two blue circles in the lower right start with a small gap and come into contact between step 0 and step 1. No large displacement, wall interaction, or controller activity is visible; they simply close the gap and touch in place.
